scripts.test:ts: for file in $(find aios/tests/unit/typescript products/posting-map/tests/unit/typescript -name '*.ts'); do npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:integration: for file in $(find aios/tests/integration products/posting-map/tests/integration -name '*.ts'); do npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:ts && npm run test:integration && npm run test:py
scripts.quality:check: npm run build && npm run architecture:test && npm run test:ts && npm run test:integration && npm run test:py
